public_body: Northampton City Council Committee Of Public Safety
overall: The AG declined to decide whether a quorum of the committee deliberated when answering reporters after a September 2010 meeting, found the meeting notice was properly posted, and ordered no remedy, only cautions.

allegations.summary: After a September 2010 committee meeting adjourned, a quorum allegedly discussed how they would vote on the tabled override while answering two reporters' questions.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to issue a determination whether the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law when answering two reporters' questions following a September 7, 2010 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee failed to post the time and place of the September 7, 2010 meeting in a conspicuous place as required.
